modalities.evidence: Resting state functional MRI data of 52 healthy participants
rsfMRI before and after one session EEG NF vs Sham NF

output.population: 52 healthy participants (22 male), ages 18 to 44, right-handed, no history of neurological or psychiatric disorders
output.summary: Resting-state functional MRI collected immediately before and after a single session of real or sham infra-low frequency EEG neurofeedback in healthy right-handed adults.
